title: Read the whole fishbone
brief: A ward team is reviewing repeated delays in giving the first antibiotic dose for suspected sepsis. The fishbone groups possible contributors instead of blaming the last person in the chain.

exhibit.title: Possible causes of delayed first antibiotic dose

task.stem: What is the best next use of this fishbone?

options.label: Choose the person named most often and retrain them.
Verify the leading hypotheses with observations and data before selecting changes.
Treat every listed cause as proven and launch all changes at once.
Calculate a control limit for each branch.

debrief.correct: Correct. A fishbone organizes hypotheses; it does not prove causation. Verify the strongest process and system hypotheses before choosing a focused test of change.
debrief.wrong: The branches contain hypotheses, not verdicts. Use observation, record review, and small tests to learn which contributors actually drive the delay.
debrief.rule_cited: Systems-based cause analysis — hypotheses require verification before action.
